dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped annuli with high-contrast, serrated light-pixel perimeters surrounding darker interiors. Edge geometry is highly irregular with varying thicknesses in the light-intensity bands.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters localized along the anterior dorsal and neck regions. These clusters lack internal dark gradients and appear as solid localized intensity peaks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of four smaller annuli in the mid-lateral region forms an irregular quadrilateral configuration.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible series of vertical, parallel skin folds or ridges present in the anterior neck region, perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of the body. Distinct singular high-intensity specular reflection point visible on the ocular region.
